justification: Both depict standing human figures wearing elaborate headdresses arranged in a composed scene, but the specific iconography differs sharply: A shows a complex multi-figure narrative around a central tree with numerous surrounding symbolic elements and a stepped/wave base register, while B shows two facing figures with winged or feathered attire and a text band above, lacking any tree, stepped platform, or wave motif. The rendering conventions also differ, A uses dense low-relief carving with intricate glyphic framing typical of a narrative relief, whereas B uses a more open, elongated figural style with a script band, so the correspondence is limited to the generic presence of adorned human figures rather than a shared specific scheme.
